acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Gargoyles family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Guardian, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Relief-Dive Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Standing upright figure with carved relief detail, broad functional wings, and glowing amber seams at the joints.
Signature mechanic: Cornice Route: amber seams illuminate shoulder, elbow, and ankle reliefs in order while broad functional wings bank toward the matching dive lane.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a true aerial threat that traces one carved relief route before a broad-wing dive.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 chipped sandstone, tiny useless wings, perch chip, and crude water-spout mouth gain one crystal mortar key; T2 granite, moss, and small wings gain sediment-set hop joints; T3 broad wings, carved relief, and amber seams gain load ribs; T4 marble, bronze, and tracery gain fracture braces; T5 buttress wings, throne, and attendants gain bounded throne faults.

Motion/process branches: T1 one short perch drop loads the water-spout mortar key; T2 a hop with small wings commits one granite joint; T3 the dive with broad wings transfers load through relief ribs; T4 a tracery aisle plants through its bronze brace; T5 each attendant command loads and releases one throne fault.
counterplay: Track the seam order, cross through the unlit segment, and strike the wing hinge after the dive commits. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the chipped-sandstone perch and tiny wings expose the water-spout mortar fault after landing; T2 the granite moss line and small-wing hinge expose a loaded joint after the hop; T3 broad wings and amber relief seams expose a load-rib fracture after the dive; T4 marble, bronze, and tracery expose the committed brace; T5 buttress wings, throne, and attendants expose the commanded throne fault after its load releases.
identityInvariants: Squat crouched construction, hunched shoulders, horned beast face, clawed grip, and folded architectural wings remain recognizable.
Sandstone, granite, marble, bronze, mortar, moss, and water staining remain discrete built materials rather than flesh.
Relief carving, water-spout mouths, restrained amber seams, and pedestal fragments preserve the architectural source grammar.
Stone quality and wing architecture escalate from useless carved flaps to sovereign buttresses while load-bearing joints stay readable.
telegraph: The upright body turns, broad wings lock, and three amber seams light along one carved relief path.
